summary: GDL Fund filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing that Mario J. Gabelli was hospitalized after a medical incident on March 19, 2026. The board implemented GAMCO's succession plan on March 22, 2026, naming Christopher J. Marangi as President. Day-to-day operations continue under co-CEOs Douglas R. Jamieson and Marangi; Willis Brucker manages the fund's portfolio during Gabelli's absence. No price, premium, or deal terms are provided. The filing is a routine current report triggered by an abrupt leadership change. Watch for Gabelli's recovery timeline and any further operational adjustments or shareholder communications.
